sequence.title: WELCOME TO VEYRON
sequence.purpose: Introduce the player character, the three Veyron worlds, the city and the idea that the player's choices shape their life.

sequence.title: YOUR LIFE STARTS HERE
sequence.purpose: Show the selected life path and transition the player into the recommended district and first-day onboarding.

life_variants.legitimate: Show work, family, commerce, property and the pressure to stay clean.
life_variants.criminal: Show crews, opportunities, risk, police presence and the cost of getting caught.
life_variants.law_enforcement: Show patrols, dispatch, public service and the requirement that a human/admin accept the application.

rule: Cinematics use original characters, locations, audio and animation; no copied third-party game assets.
